Username: shootingbambi 

(yes the alex skin is an intimidation)

position. Rush good(I like to tunnel if that's what I gotta do). mid i can chokehold well. And defense if I'm with another person.

discord: Sherlock poems


timezone: America Central Time

When am I available: so at about 5 - 5:30 I will start playing and I'll stop at like 8 or 9, maybe later.
on weekends, I play at around 1 if I'm home, then possibly later at night.

anything else? Well I'm not the best a pvp  but I'm way better than when I played on crede or stuff. My bridging is a 10/10, and my bow skills are a 8/10. Sword more of a 7/10. my average cps when I'm pvping is around, 5 cps, and bridging its 12. I don't jitterclick unless I'm like laughing while playing. Or crying. I used to love DTM but about a month ago I started playing ctw way more because I can rush way better. I wish my appeal would go from Reviewing » accepted, but I'm still waiting for a reply. I don't know most of the players, and I know they are good. I typically don't like being a trial because it's like I get one chance to play with the team and I might fail. But u know. I'm sorry I'm a writer and a lesbean so it took me forever to write this

Peace
